tips.title: Important tips for using internet banking
tips.files: Do not open files sent by unknown sites and do not click the links they send.
tips.antivirus: Use an up-to-date antivirus and back up the important files on your computer.
tips.password: Where possible, use a strong password that mixes letters, digits and symbols.
tips.logout: Always sign out when you are done; closing the browser does not sign you out.
